model_architecture:
Modelo(
  (moving_avg): MovingAvg(
    (avg): AvgPool1d(kernel_size=(49,), stride=(1,), padding=(0,))
  )
  (linear_seasonal): Linear(in_features=96, out_features=24, bias=True)
  (linear_trend): Linear(in_features=96, out_features=24, bias=True)
)
forward_code:
def forward(self, x):
        # x: [batch, seq_len, 1]
        x = x[:, :, 0]                     # [batch, seq_len]

        trend = self.moving_avg(x)         # [batch, seq_len]
        seasonal = x - trend               # [batch, seq_len]

        seasonal_out = self.linear_seasonal(seasonal)   # [batch, horizon]
        trend_out = self.linear_trend(trend)             # [batch, horizon]

        return seasonal_out + trend_out
